relevance_note: Two Tangier disease patients with ABCA1 variants are described individually: "Whole-exome analysis showed compound heterozygosity for a W484* nonsense mutation and S1343I missense mutation, which confirmed Tangier disease".
method_note: Hand-built with a short Python script from my own reading; no table transcribed by script. Table 1 has patients as columns (Case 1, Case 2); variant strings taken from its 'ABCA1 substitutions found (nt/aa)' rows, recorded as printed. Labels: the text uses 'case 1' (12x) more than 'Case 1' (5x); 'case 2'/'Case 2' tie (4/4), lowercase chosen for consistency. Contradiction/typo: Table 1 prints 'G4028T/S13431' while the text everywhere gives 'S1343I'; variant_original_string keeps the table string, protein field uses the text 'S1343I'. Nucleotide changes are printed without a 'c.' prefix (e.g. G1452A); recorded in cdna_hgvs_as_stated as printed; no transcript printed. Table 1 symbols '-' and '＋' (Atherosclerosis, Typical TD phenotype) are not defined in the legend, so not used as evidence; case 1 has '-' for Atherosclerosis while the text reports a mild right subclavian plaque, which I recorded as observed (non-coronary atherosclerotic arterial disease). Peripheral neuropathy for case 1 recorded as observed from 'decreased nerve conduction velocity' (the paper does not use the word neuropathy for case 1). ApoA1 values (17 and 2.0 mg/dL), LDL and triglyceride values are printed without being called low/high, so low apoA-I, low LDL and hypertriglyceridemia are left not reported. Case 1 also has GALC variants (12del3ins and L380F) and Krabbe disease; both GALC variants get rows for case 1 (attributed unambiguously); zygosity not stated; '12del3ins' kept as printed with no notation assigned (cDNA/protein unclear), and only L380F given variant type missense ('12del3ins and L380F missense mutations' does not make an indel missense). Parents of case 2 (father HDL ~30 mg/dL, no cardiovascular complications; mother died in her 60s of lung cancer) are described only in the Fig. 2B legend, with no stated genetic testing and no stated Tangier features; I treated them as out of scope (not tested, not affected). Parents of case 1 are in scope (tested by whole-exon analysis). Father's zygosity left not reported ('carrier' only). Case 1 age at last evaluation is the age on admission (Table 1); case 2 was referred at 49 but Table 1 gives 51 on admission; 51 recorded. Pathogenicity: only S1343I is called 'novel' for a specific variant; W484*, S1343I and R579* are said to be 'unknown' (previously unreported) and R1572* 'known', which are not classifications, so left not reported for the others.
